title: Electrospray Ionization Mass Spectrometry Insights into the Assembly of Lanthanide-Containing Clusters
claim: The mass difference fingerprint of isomorphism (MDFI) method estimates lanthanide nuclearity from corresponding peaks of analogous clusters containing two different lanthanide elements.
explanation: For matched species with the same ligands and charge, their mass-to-charge difference reflects the number of substituted lanthanide ions and the difference in those elements' atomic masses.
scope: Paired, plausibly isomorphic lanthanide-cluster species with identifiable corresponding ESI-MS peaks.
conditions: The compared species must have the same non-lanthanide composition and known corresponding charge states.
caveats: Matching species in the two solutions is an assumption to check; MDFI determines a metal count rather than a complete formula or structure.
